Not long ago, a media friend told me about a scene he witnessed at an event. The reporter sitting to his right had an AI voice recorder and an AI assistant on his computer open at the same time. Before the interview even ended, the materials were already being organized. The reporter sitting to his left, however, was still taking notes by hand with a pen and notebook, planning to type them into Word after returning. The two sat in the same event, but seemed to be from two different eras.

Over the past six months, based on observations of my own colleagues and media friends, the differences in how deeply people use AI are now enormous. Some have already reached a level close to "mastery." From topic research, interview preparation, and audio transcription to meeting notes, article structure, and headline generation, AI has penetrated almost every step of content production. But other journalists are still using the same working methods as ten years ago: manual notes, manual organization, and then opening Word to write character by character.

items.raw_excerpt: 8月3日，阿里巴巴正式发布新一代基座大模型Qwen3.8，编程与Agent能力大幅提升，整体性能位居全球大模型第一梯队。发布当日，OpenRouter、OpenCode、Hermes Agent、Command Code、Vercel、Novita、Charm、DeepInfra等多家海外主流API聚合、Agent工具及开发者平台纷纷拥抱Qwen3.8-Max，形成了一股“接入潮”。 Hermes Agent、OpenCode、Command Code是当下最热门的AI Agent/Coding Agent工具，在发布当日就官宣支持，意味着开发者可以直接通过成熟的三方工具平台调用Qwen3.8，将极大放大中国模型在AI落地中的全球影响力。同时，OpenRouter、Novita、Vercel等主流模型调用平台同步上线Qwen3.8-Max，全球开发者和企业都能更方便、高效地调用，推动千问走入更多真实的企业级复杂场景中去。 据了解，最新发布的Qwen3.8模型总参数达2.4万亿、激活95B，支持1M Tokens长上下文与视觉理解，并在自主编程与长程任务执行方面具备端到端交付能力。在考察模型基础文本能力的TextArena榜中，Qwen3.8仅次于Claude系列模型，在评测代码水平的CodeArena榜中斩获全球第四，在视觉能力全球榜单Vision Arena中排名全球第二。据阿里官方发布信息，Qwen3.8-Max预计下周开源，为Qwen-Max级模型首次，并将开源备受开发者瞩目的Qwen3.8-27B。截至目前，阿里已开源400多款千问大模型，全球衍生模型数量超20万个，下载量超10亿次，稳居全球开源大模型生态首位。
